title: gilia multicaulis var. millefoliata
intro: Gilia multicaulis var. millefoliata, commonly known as Western Yarrow or Prairie Yarrow, is a perennial plant species native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it effective in treating wounds, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Gilia multicaulis var. millefoliata include astringent, diaphoretic, and emmenagogue properties, which help in reducing bleeding, promoting sweating, and regulating menstrual cycles. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in herbal medicine.
